lines.en: I glide over the riverbed stones.
The current pushes; I swing my tail with it.
The Cretaceous river ran clearer than this.
I skim the sand, hunting for food.

lines.zh: 长吻在前，先探到石头缝。
lines.en: My long snout probes the cracks first.
One sweep of my tail and the silt rises.
I swim along the shadow of the bank.
Only deep water feels right.
There is an eddy in the bend.
I turn half a circle there.

lines.zh: 鱼鳞擦过水草，声音很轻。
lines.en: My scales brush the weed with a faint sound.
This river runs under the cliff.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头上面滑过去。
lines.en: I slide over a stone.

lines.zh: 水草挂在我背上，我不在意。
lines.en: Weed trails over my back; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 河道的弯我一天要转十几回。
lines.en: I round this bend a dozen times a day.

lines.zh: 浅处我不去，那里容易卡住。
lines.en: I avoid the shallows; they snag me.
I know where the current goes.
The current slips past my fins.
Light dapples the stones below.
I hug the stones on the riverbed.
Something moves in the silt.
I wait for it to emerge.
This stretch of water sounds familiar.
I hatched here.
The water is darker toward the marsh.

lines.zh: 我用吻翻了一块小石头。
lines.en: I flip a small stone with my snout.
Nothing underneath.
A small fish passes my snout.
The surface is perfectly still.
The riverbed stones are slick.
You are standing on the bank.

lines.zh: 河岸的倒影里，多了一个人。
lines.en: There's a person in the riverbank reflection.
I swim to the edge of it.
Your shadow falls into the shallows.
My snout is longer than your palm.
Come down and the water will cloud.
You crouched at the water's edge.
Your hand reached into the water.
I saw it all.
The surface moves, so you cannot see me.
Blood spreads in the water.
I swing my tail away.
The river sand half-buries me.
With this I can still swim.
The water has clouded; that helps.
One of my fins is gone.
I list to one side as I swim.
I hide under a stone.
Blood mixes with the water; I sink.
I sink a little deeper.
Something drifted down the water.
Could that be a worm?
I open my mouth to catch it.
This tastes quite good.
Drop a little more.
You still have some left.
Do not throw it too far.
Is that a piece of bread?
No, it is worms.
That is even better, then.
You stepped into the shallows.

lines.zh: 被撞得打了个转，泥浆散开。
lines.en: Knocked into a spin, silt blooming around me.
I swim around you.
Your leg is beside me.

lines.zh: 地狱溪的河，我游了千万年。
lines.en: I've swum Hell Creek's rivers for ages.
The sand settles again.
Your boot stirs up a cloud of mud.
Now I cannot see.
I rise a little.
The water clears again.
There are a few others in this river.
In spring, when the water warms.
Look at the pits in the riverbed.
We made those.
I do not quite follow you.

lines.zh: 河湾里有几条跟我一样的。
lines.en: There are others like me in the bend.
Their snouts are shorter than mine.
It only gets busy once the water warms.
I wait for it to circle first.

lines.zh: 我绕着那条鱼转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle the other fish twice.

lines.zh: 沙里闪了一下，我凑过去。
lines.en: Something glints in the sand; I drift closer.
I swim over to look.
It is only a stone.
I nudge it; it rolls into a crevice.
The sand covers it again.
It is stuck in a rock crevice.
I push my snout in to touch it.
I cannot reach it.
I give up on it.
The sand buries it once more.
A strange smell is in the water.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的河，我只有半格长。
lines.en: Half a block long in a Cretaceous river.
I turn along the water.
Over in the shallows.
I do not swim fast.
But I do not stop.
The shadow on the surface has grown.
I turn along the current.

lines.zh: 你站在浅处，那里我够得着。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows; I can reach there.
I hear footsteps on the bank.
The sound comes down through the water.
I drift slowly toward the shallows.
I close in along the current.

lines.zh: 你在岸上走，我在水里跟。
lines.en: You walk the bank; I follow below.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，水就震一下。
lines.en: Each step of yours shakes the water.
Underwater I hear it perfectly.
I swim along the bank's shadow.

lines.zh: 你每走一步我都能感觉到。
lines.en: I feel every step you take.
The surface carries sound fast.
I need not look up.
You stop to look into the water.
I am in the dark at your feet.

lines.zh: 你的脚在水里，水纹一圈圈散。
lines.en: Your feet in the water send rings outward.
I follow the direction of the rings.
The weeds catch my fins.
I swing my tail at your shin.
My snout strikes your knee.

lines.zh: 河底的沙，我一口一口筛。
lines.en: I sieve the riverbed sand mouthful by mouthful.

lines.zh: 我在泥里一转身，又冲回来。
lines.en: I turn in the mud and charge again.

lines.zh: 我从水里窜起来撞你的腿。
lines.en: I burst up and strike your leg.
A spray of water.
You step back into empty footing.
And I sink again.

lines.zh: 我的吻顶在你的膝盖上。
lines.en: My snout rams your knee.
You stagger and water splashes onto the bank.
I ride the current into another blow.
Your footing is failing.
The sand on the bed is washed open.
I swim out of the dark.
This river is shallow, but enough.
Light comes down through the surface.
I stop beside a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 腐叶落在水面，我浮过去。
lines.en: Leaves rot on the surface; I drift up.
The river runs over me.
The silt stirs, and I swim out.
There is light in the shallows.
I know this channel.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的水温比这里低。
lines.en: The Cretaceous water ran colder than this.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己怎么来的。
lines.en: I cannot recall how I came here.
The bank's soil is new.
I circle once along the bank.

lines.zh: 热水灌进来，我拼命往下潜。
lines.en: Hot water pours in; I dive as deep as I can.
I am washed off the shallows.

lines.zh: 空气没了，我张嘴乱咬水。
lines.en: There is no air; I gape at the water.

lines.zh: 水底一震，泥沙全翻起来。
lines.en: The bed jolts and silt boils up.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎穿了我的鳍。
lines.en: Something sharp pierces my fin.

lines.zh: 水里的光让我一阵发麻。
lines.en: The light in the water numbs me.

lines.zh: 水底什么也没有，我越游越慢。
lines.en: Nothing on the bed; I swim slower and slower.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，一道白光穿过去。
lines.en: Lightning enters the river, a white streak through it.
The water is gone all at once.
